questions.q: Classify each substance as an element, a compound, a homogeneous mixture or a heterogeneous mixture: (a) copper, (b) carbon dioxide, (c) air, (d) muddy water.
questions.qAf: Klassifiseer elke stof as ’n element, ’n verbinding, ’n homogene mengsel of ’n heterogene mengsel: (a) koper, (b) koolstofdioksied, (c) lug, (d) modderwater.

questions.q: Define a compound.
questions.qAf: Definieer ’n verbinding.
points: A pure substance made of two or more different elements
chemically bonded in a fixed ratio
pointsAf: ’n Suiwer stof wat uit twee of meer verskillende elemente bestaan
wat chemies in ’n vaste verhouding gebind is

questions.q: Name the separation technique you would use to obtain: (a) salt from salt water, (b) sand from a mixture of sand and water, (c) ethanol from a mixture of ethanol and water, (d) the different dyes in ink.
questions.qAf: Noem die skeidingstegniek wat jy sal gebruik om die volgende te verkry: (a) sout uit soutwater, (b) sand uit ’n mengsel van sand en water, (c) etanol uit ’n mengsel van etanol en water, (d) die verskillende kleurstowwe in ink.

questions.q: On which property does distillation depend? Explain briefly.
questions.qAf: Van watter eienskap hang distillasie af? Verduidelik kortliks.
points: The liquids have different boiling points
the liquid with the lower boiling point evaporates first and is condensed and collected
pointsAf: die vloeistof met die laer kookpunt verdamp eerste en word gekondenseer en opgevang

questions.q: Give TWO physical properties of metals.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE fisiese eienskappe van metale.
points: Good conductors of heat and electricity
pointsAf: Goeie geleiers van hitte en elektrisiteit

questions.q: Describe the arrangement and the movement of the particles in a solid.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die rangskikking en die beweging van die deeltjies in ’n vaste stof.
points: they vibrate about their fixed positions
pointsAf: hulle vibreer om hul vaste posisies

questions.scenario: The heating curve below shows how the temperature of a substance changes as it is heated at a constant rate.
questions.scenarioAf: Die verhittingskurwe hieronder toon hoe die temperatuur van ’n stof verander terwyl dit teen ’n konstante tempo verhit word.

questions.q: What is happening to the substance between B and C?
questions.qAf: Wat gebeur met die stof tussen B en C?

questions.q: Explain why the temperature stays constant between D and E even though the substance is still being heated.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die temperatuur tussen D en E konstant bly al word die stof steeds verhit.
points: The energy is used to overcome the intermolecular forces (boiling)
and not to increase the kinetic energy of the particles
pointsAf: Die energie word gebruik om die intermolekulêre kragte te oorkom (kook)
en nie om die kinetiese energie van die deeltjies te verhoog nie

questions.q: A metal block has a mass of 54 g and a volume of 20 cm³. Calculate its density.
questions.qAf: ’n Metaalblok het ’n massa van 54 g en ’n volume van 20 cm³. Bereken sy digtheid.

questions.q: Classify each change as physical or chemical: (a) iron rusting, (b) salt dissolving in water, (c) a cake baking.
questions.qAf: Klassifiseer elke verandering as fisies of chemies: (a) yster wat roes, (b) sout wat in water oplos, (c) ’n koek wat bak.

questions.q: Give TWO observations that show that a chemical change has taken place.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE waarnemings wat toon dat ’n chemiese verandering plaasgevind het.
points: A gas is given off, or a colour change
a precipitate forms, or heat or light is given off
pointsAf: ’n neerslag vorm, of hitte of lig word vrygestel

questions.q: Name the scientist whose gold foil experiment led to the discovery of the nucleus.
questions.qAf: Noem die wetenskaplike wie se goudfoelie-eksperiment tot die ontdekking van die kern gelei het.

questions.q: Give TWO conclusions from the gold foil experiment.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE gevolgtrekkings uit die goudfoelie-eksperiment.
points: Most of the atom is empty space
the positive charge and most of the mass are concentrated in a small nucleus
pointsAf: Die grootste deel van die atoom is leë ruimte
die positiewe lading en die meeste van die massa is in ’n klein kern gekonsentreer

questions.q: Write down the number of protons, neutrons and electrons in this atom.
questions.qAf: Skryf die aantal protone, neutrone en elektrone in hierdie atoom neer.

questions.q: How many electrons does the ion Al³⁺ have?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel elektrone het die ioon Al³⁺?

questions.q: Define the term mass number.
questions.qAf: Definieer die term massagetal.
points: The number of protons plus neutrons in the nucleus of an atom
pointsAf: Die aantal protone plus neutrone in die kern van ’n atoom

questions.q: Define isotopes.
questions.qAf: Definieer isotope.
points: Atoms of the same element with the same number of protons
but a different number of neutrons
pointsAf: Atome van dieselfde element met dieselfde aantal protone

questions.q: Naturally occurring chlorine is 75% chlorine-35 and 25% chlorine-37. Calculate the relative atomic mass of chlorine.
questions.qAf: Chloor wat natuurlik voorkom, is 75% chloor-35 en 25% chloor-37. Bereken die relatiewe atoommassa van chloor.

questions.q: Write down the electron configuration (sp notation) of sodium.
questions.qAf: Skryf die elektronkonfigurasie (sp-notasie) van natrium neer.

questions.q: Explain why a substance gives a flame of a specific colour when it is heated in a flame.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom ’n stof ’n vlam van ’n spesifieke kleur gee wanneer dit in ’n vlam verhit word.
points: Electrons absorb energy and move to higher energy levels
they fall back to lower energy levels
releasing light of specific energies (colours), because the energy levels are fixed (quantised)
pointsAf: Elektrone absorbeer energie en beweeg na hoër energievlakke
hulle val terug na laer energievlakke
en stel lig van spesifieke energieë (kleure) vry, omdat die energievlakke vas (gekwantiseer) is

questions.q: Define first ionisation energy.
questions.qAf: Definieer eerste ionisasie-energie.
points: The energy needed to remove one electron
from an atom in the gas phase
pointsAf: Die energie wat nodig is om een elektron te verwyder

questions.q: Describe and explain the trend in first ionisation energy across period 3 from left to right.
questions.qAf: Beskryf en verduidelik die neiging in eerste ionisasie-energie oor periode 3 van links na regs.
points: the nuclear charge increases while electrons are added to the same energy level
so the outer electrons are held more strongly and are harder to remove
pointsAf: die kernlading neem toe terwyl elektrone by dieselfde energievlak gevoeg word
dus word die buitenste elektrone sterker vasgehou en is hulle moeiliker om te verwyder

questions.q: Explain why the Group 1 metals react more vigorously further down the group.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die Groep 1-metale verder af in die groep heftiger reageer.
points: The atomic radius increases down the group
the outer electron is further from the nucleus and more shielded
so the ionisation energy is lower and the electron is lost more easily
pointsAf: Die atoomradius neem afwaarts in die groep toe
die buitenste elektron is verder van die kern en meer afgeskerm
dus is die ionisasie-energie laer en word die elektron makliker verloor

questions.scenario: Element X is in Group 2 and period 3.
questions.scenarioAf: Element X is in Groep 2 en periode 3.

questions.q: Identify element X.
questions.qAf: Identifiseer element X.

questions.q: Write down the formula of the ion that X forms.
questions.qAf: Skryf die formule van die ioon wat X vorm neer.

questions.q: Write down the formula of the compound formed between X and chlorine.
questions.qAf: Skryf die formule van die verbinding wat tussen X en chloor vorm neer.

questions.q: Define electronegativity.
questions.qAf: Definieer elektronegatiwiteit.
points: The tendency of an atom in a molecule
pointsAf: Die neiging van ’n atoom in ’n molekuul
om die bindingselektrone aan te trek

questions.q: Explain why the noble gases are unreactive.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die edelgasse onreaktief is.
points: They have a full outer energy level (stable octet)
so they do not easily gain, lose or share electrons
pointsAf: Hulle het ’n vol buitenste energievlak (stabiele oktet)
dus wen, verloor of deel hulle nie maklik elektrone nie

questions.q: Define a covalent bond.
questions.qAf: Definieer ’n kovalente binding.

questions.q: Describe the Lewis diagram of a water (H₂O) molecule.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die Lewis-diagram van ’n watermolekuul (H₂O).
points: Two bonding pairs, one between O and each H
two lone pairs on the oxygen atom
pointsAf: Twee bindingspare, een tussen O en elke H

questions.q: Write down the shape of a water molecule.
questions.qAf: Skryf die vorm van ’n watermolekuul neer.

questions.q: Is a water molecule polar or non-polar? Explain.
questions.qAf: Is ’n watermolekuul polêr of nie-polêr? Verduidelik.
points: the O–H bonds are polar because O is much more electronegative than H
and the angular shape makes the charge distribution asymmetrical
pointsAf: die O–H-bindings is polêr omdat O baie meer elektronegatief as H is
en die hoekige vorm maak die ladingsverspreiding asimmetries

questions.q: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) has polar bonds, but the molecule is non-polar. Explain.
questions.qAf: Koolstofdioksied (CO₂) het polêre bindings, maar die molekuul is nie-polêr. Verduidelik.
points: so it is symmetrical and the bond dipoles cancel
pointsAf: dus is dit simmetries en die bindingsdipole kanselleer

questions.q: Describe how the ionic bond in sodium chloride forms.
questions.qAf: Beskryf hoe die ioniese binding in natriumchloried vorm.
points: A sodium atom loses one electron to form Na⁺
a chlorine atom gains that electron to form Cl⁻
the oppositely charged ions attract each other (electrostatic attraction)
pointsAf: ’n Natriumatoom verloor een elektron om Na⁺ te vorm
’n Chlooratoom wen daardie elektron om Cl⁻ te vorm
die teenoorgesteld gelaaide ione trek mekaar aan (elektrostatiese aantrekking)

questions.q: Describe metallic bonding.
questions.qAf: Beskryf metaalbinding.
points: held together by a sea of delocalised electrons
pointsAf: wat deur ’n see van gedelokaliseerde elektrone saamgehou word

questions.q: Explain why metals conduct electricity.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom metale elektrisiteit gelei.
points: The delocalised electrons are free to move through the metal
pointsAf: Die gedelokaliseerde elektrone kan vrylik deur die metaal beweeg

questions.q: Balance the equation: Al + O₂ → Al₂O₃
questions.qAf: Balanseer die vergelyking: Al + O₂ → Al₂O₃

questions.q: Balance the equation: C₃H₈ + O₂ → CO₂ + H₂O
questions.qAf: Balanseer die vergelyking: C₃H₈ + O₂ → CO₂ + H₂O

questions.q: State the law of conservation of mass.
questions.qAf: Stel die wet van behoud van massa.
points: Mass is neither created nor destroyed in a chemical reaction
the total mass of the reactants equals the total mass of the products
pointsAf: Massa word nie in ’n chemiese reaksie geskep of vernietig nie
die totale massa van die reaktanse is gelyk aan die totale massa van die produkte

questions.q: Use the reaction 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O to show that mass is conserved.
questions.qAf: Gebruik die reaksie 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O om te toon dat massa behoue bly.

questions.q: Name the type of each reaction: (a) CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂, (b) Zn + CuSO₄ → ZnSO₄ + Cu, (c) CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O.
questions.qAf: Noem die soort elke reaksie: (a) CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂, (b) Zn + CuSO₄ → ZnSO₄ + Cu, (c) CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O.

questions.q: What is an electrolyte?
questions.qAf: Wat is ’n elektroliet?
points: A substance that forms ions when it dissolves in water
so that the solution conducts electricity
pointsAf: ’n Stof wat ione vorm wanneer dit in water oplos

questions.q: Write a balanced equation, with state symbols, for the dissociation of sodium chloride in water.
questions.qAf: Skryf ’n gebalanseerde vergelyking, met toestandsimbole, vir die dissosiasie van natriumchloried in water.

questions.q: Explain how water molecules surround the ions when sodium chloride dissolves (hydration).
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe watermolekules die ione omring wanneer natriumchloried oplos (hidrasie).
points: the δ⁻ oxygen ends face the Na⁺ ions and the δ⁺ hydrogen ends face the Cl⁻ ions
pointsAf: die δ⁻-suurstofkante wys na die Na⁺-ione en die δ⁺-waterstofkante na die Cl⁻-ione

questions.scenario: Barium chloride solution is added to sodium sulfate solution and a white precipitate forms.
questions.scenarioAf: Bariumchloriedoplossing word by natriumsulfaatoplossing gevoeg en ’n wit neerslag vorm.

questions.q: Name the precipitate.
questions.qAf: Noem die neerslag.

questions.q: Write a balanced equation, with state symbols, for the reaction.
questions.qAf: Skryf ’n gebalanseerde vergelyking, met toestandsimbole, vir die reaksie.

questions.q: Write the net ionic equation for the reaction.
questions.qAf: Skryf die netto ioniese vergelyking vir die reaksie.

questions.q: Which conducts electricity better: a sugar solution or a salt solution? Explain.
questions.qAf: Watter een gelei elektrisiteit beter: ’n suikeroplossing of ’n soutoplossing? Verduidelik.
points: salt dissociates into free ions, while sugar dissolves as neutral molecules
pointsAf: sout dissosieer in vry ione, terwyl suiker as neutrale molekules oplos

sections.title: Quantitative aspects of chemical change

questions.q: Define one mole of a substance.
questions.qAf: Definieer een mol van ’n stof.
points: The amount of substance that contains the same number of particles
as there are atoms in 12 g of carbon-12 (6,02 × 10²³ particles)
pointsAf: Die hoeveelheid stof wat dieselfde aantal deeltjies bevat
as wat daar atome in 12 g koolstof-12 is (6,02 × 10²³ deeltjies)

questions.q: Calculate the percentage of calcium by mass in CaCO₃.
questions.qAf: Bereken die persentasie kalsium volgens massa in CaCO₃.

questions.qAf: Bereken die volume van hierdie CO₂ by STD.

questions.q: What is the hydrosphere?
questions.qAf: Wat is die hidrosfeer?
points: in all its forms: oceans, rivers, ice, groundwater and water vapour
pointsAf: in al sy vorme: oseane, riviere, ys, grondwater en waterdamp

questions.q: Name TWO processes in the water cycle that are driven by energy from the Sun.
questions.qAf: Noem TWEE prosesse in die watersiklus wat deur energie van die Son aangedryf word.

questions.q: Explain why water is called the universal solvent.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom water die universele oplosmiddel genoem word.
points: so water dissolves many ionic and polar substances
pointsAf: dus los water baie ioniese en polêre stowwe op

questions.q: South Africa is a water-scarce country. Give TWO ways in which a household can save water.
questions.qAf: Suid-Afrika is ’n waterskaars land. Gee TWEE maniere waarop ’n huishouding water kan bespaar.
points: Take shorter showers, or fix leaking taps
collect rainwater, or reuse grey water for the garden
pointsAf: Stort korter, of herstel lekkende krane
vang reënwater op, of hergebruik gryswater vir die tuin
